notes.title: I'm back to developing!
notes.notes:
After a long break to work on some other titles, I am back to working on Quiver Quest! Hopefully I will be able to knock out some stuff on the roadmap before I have to go back to other projects. I plan to post daily updates on what I'm working on in the Community Hub. So, keep your eyes peeled. 

If you have any feature requests, please let me know in the Community Hub : )

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Info
notes.notes: We currently have no plans to support steam deck for the foreseeable future. We may make the game playable on a PC but it is mainly intended to be for VR.

notes.title: Quiver Quest Available On Meta Quest!
notes.notes:
After a full revamp of the game, we are exited to announce the new version of Quiver Quest will be available on the Meta Store as well as here on Steam! We have made our development cross-platform, ensuring both stores will have the same game. The only difference will be graphical effects such as realtime shadows, underwater effects, and post-processing will be removed or disabled on the Meta Store version to ensure adequate performance. Both version will be able to use the same multiplayer room, allowing players from both platforms to interact.

Check us out here [url=https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/3982099088544024/]Quiver Quest On Meta Quest[/url]
